title: Anthropic pitches AI safety bill that may block a model if 50+ people could be killed
script:
Fifty deaths or one billion dollars in damage is Anthropic's new threshold for AI.
Dario Amodei leads Anthropic as chief executive officer.
The proposed safety bill forbids federal agencies from blocking a model without permission from a judge.
This legislation effectively makes the Commerce Department the sole agency capable of stopping a release.
Federal courts would decide if Claude or competing systems cross the danger line.
Would you trust a judge to halt a dangerous AI model?
